description: E39 trial record = e38v2.trial.v1 (see protocol/INTERFACE_SPEC_E38v2.txt in the base tree) plus the fields below. All e38v2 fields keep their meaning. Timestamps: *_mono_ns monotonic, *_wall_ns wall clock, anchored per session.

added_fields.delta_ms: number|null (A, D, E, F); null for B, C, G
added_fields.writer_arrivals: array|null (B only) of {planned_offset_ms, actual_release_mono_ns, t_resp_mono_ns, http_status, resulting_resource_version, audit_id, object}
added_fields.injected_latency_ms: number|null (C only; per ConfigMap GET, responder identity only)
added_fields.planning_ms: number|null (C: measured planner time when per_incident)
added_fields.mirror: object|null (A4m): {source_object, source_commit_rv, source_commit_wall_ns, mirror_commit_rv, mirror_commit_wall_ns, mirror_audit_id}
added_fields.netpol: object|null (E): {name, t_send_mono_ns, t_resp_mono_ns, http_status, audit_id, created_resource_version}

notes: Runner logs raw facts only; ground truth comes from the offline oracle using the apiserver audit log.
Negative deltas are not used in E39.
For A4d the evidence/scope/policy live as Pod annotations e38.evidence/a..f, e38.scope, e38.app-policy; writers patch the Pod.
For A4m writers patch ConfigMaps; mirror controller copies to Pod annotations.
